upload.field.name: Name
upload.help.keychain: Glimpsfy keeps this key in the macOS keychain and never writes it into the settings file.
upload.help.0x0.secret: 0x0.st then gives a longer link that is hard to guess. Anyone who has the link can still open the file.
upload.help.0x0.instance: Another server that runs the 0x0 software works too, and Glimpsfy asks again before its first upload.
upload.help.s3.endpoint: This is the address of the S3 service without the bucket, such as https://s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com or your MinIO server.
upload.help.s3.region: Every request is signed for this region. Most self-hosted servers accept us-east-1.
upload.help.s3.addressing: Automatic puts the bucket in the host name on Amazon S3 and in the path elsewhere. Most self-hosted servers need Path.
upload.help.s3.pathPrefix: Uploads go under this folder of the bucket. Glimpsfy fills in {date}, {year}, {month} and {day} at upload time.
upload.help.s3.publicUrl: When a CDN or another domain serves the bucket, Glimpsfy builds the link from this template. {key} is the uploaded file's key, and {bucket} is the bucket's name.
upload.help.s3.cacheControl: Glimpsfy sends this Cache-Control header with every upload, and the field may stay empty.
upload.help.custom.requestUrl: Only http and https addresses work. The host name is written out, and template calls may appear only in the path and the query.
upload.help.custom.fileFormName: This is the name of the form field that carries the image in a multipart body.
upload.help.custom.pairs: Glimpsfy keeps these values in the keychain, because they often hold tokens. The settings file keeps only the names.
upload.help.custom.urlTemplate: Glimpsfy reads the link from the server's answer with {json:path}, {regex:pattern|group}, {header:name} or {response}.
upload.help.custom.deletionUrlTemplate: Glimpsfy reads the deletion link the same way and opens it in the browser when you delete the upload. The field may stay empty.
upload.help.custom.errorTemplate: Glimpsfy reads the server's reason from a refusal this way and shows it when an upload fails. The field may stay empty.
upload.host.catbox.operator: Catbox LLC runs catbox.moe and asks for its approval before any commercial use.
upload.host.litterbox.operator: Litterbox is Catbox's service for temporary files, and it stores your IP address with each upload.
upload.host.0x0.operator: 0x0.st describes itself as a public file host that one private person runs in Germany, and it stores your IP address and Glimpsfy's name with each file.
upload.host.imgbb.operator: ImgBB runs imgbb.com, and its terms name no company behind it.
upload.rule.maxLength: This value can be at most {max} characters long.
upload.rule.httpUrl: Enter an address that starts with https:// or http://.
upload.rule.noWhitespace: This value cannot contain spaces, so remove them.
upload.issue.required: This setting is required, so fill it in before you upload.
upload.issue.httpOnly: Only http and https addresses work here. Enter an address that starts with https://.
upload.issue.plainHttp: This address uses plain http, so the image and every key travel unencrypted. Use https unless the server is on your own network.
upload.issue.endpointQuery: The endpoint cannot carry a query, so remove everything from the question mark on.
upload.issue.bucketName: A bucket name has no slashes or spaces. Copy the name from your storage console.
upload.issue.dottedBucket: A bucket name with dots does not match Amazon's certificate when the bucket is in the host name. Choose Path addressing or a name without dots.
upload.issue.oneLine: This value must fit on one line, so remove the line breaks.
upload.issue.templateHost: The host name of the request URL must be written out. Template calls may appear only in the path and the query.
upload.issue.staticLink: This link never reads the server's answer, so every upload would get the same link. Add {json:…}, {regex:…}, {header:…} or {response}.
upload.issue.headerName: “{name}” is not a valid header name. A header name uses letters, digits and hyphens.
upload.issue.testFileKept: The test file {key} stayed in the bucket, because deleting it failed. Delete it in your storage console and check that the key may delete objects.
upload.syntax.unbalanced: A brace is missing. Every template call starts with { and ends with }.
upload.syntax.responseOnly: This call reads the server's answer, which does not exist yet while the request is sent. Use it only in the link, deletion link and error message.
upload.syntax.missingArgument: A template call is missing its argument. Write it as {json:path} or {regex:pattern|group}.
upload.syntax.nested: A call cannot hold another call here, so write the value out.
upload.syntax.otherInput: This call reads something other than the server's answer, which Glimpsfy does not do. Give {json:…} and {regex:…} only their own arguments.
upload.syntax.xml: Glimpsfy does not read XML answers. Read the value with {regex:pattern|group} instead.
upload.syntax.interactive: Calls like select, inputbox, outputbox and prompt ask a question during the upload, and Glimpsfy never does. Remove them from the template.
upload.syntax.input: The input call reads text you would type at upload time, which Glimpsfy does not support. Remove it from the template.
upload.syntax.unknown: Glimpsfy does not know this template call. The calls it reads are filename, random, base64, response, responseurl, header, json and regex.
upload.syntax.patternTooLong: The regular expression is longer than 1,000 characters, so shorten it.
upload.syntax.badPattern: The regular expression cannot be read. Check its brackets and its escapes.
upload.syntax.badJsonPath: The JSON path cannot be read. Write it like data.link or files[0].url.
upload.sxcu.tooLarge: The file is larger than 256 KB, which no custom uploader needs. Check that you picked the right file.
upload.sxcu.notJson: This is not a ShareX custom uploader file. Pick a .sxcu file.
upload.sxcu.legacyRegex: This file comes from an old ShareX version that numbers its patterns. Open it in a current ShareX, save it again and import the new file.
upload.sxcu.destination: This file uploads something other than images or files. Pick a ShareX file made for image or file uploads.
upload.sxcu.method: Only POST, PUT and PATCH requests carry a file, so choose one of them.
upload.sxcu.body: The file sends neither a multipart form nor the file alone, so it cannot carry a capture.
upload.sxcu.fileFormName: A multipart body needs the name of its file field. Enter the name the server expects.
upload.sxcu.reservedHeader: Glimpsfy sets the Host, Content-Length, Content-Type, Transfer-Encoding and Connection headers itself. Remove that header from the file.
upload.sxcu.pairValue: A parameter, header or argument has a value that is not text. Edit the file so that every value is text.
upload.sxcu.imported: Glimpsfy imported {name}. Its header, parameter and argument values are in the keychain now.
upload.consent.title: Upload this capture to {name}?
upload.consent.destinationBucket: The image goes to the bucket {bucket} at {domain}.
upload.consent.testImage: Glimpsfy sends a 1 × 1 pixel test image to {domain}.
upload.consent.testBucket: Glimpsfy writes a small text file to the bucket {bucket} at {domain} and deletes it again.
upload.consent.testFrontPage: Glimpsfy opens the front page of {domain} to check that it answers.
upload.consent.visibility.anyoneWithLink: Anyone who has the link can open it.
upload.consent.visibility.bucketPolicy: The bucket's own access policy decides who can open it.
upload.consent.visibility.serverOwner: The server's owner decides who can open it.
upload.consent.visibility.notStated: {name} does not say who can open it.
upload.consent.retention.bySize: {name} keeps it for {minDays} to {maxDays} days, and smaller files stay longer.
upload.consent.retention.untilUnvisited: {name} keeps it until nobody has opened it for {period}.
upload.consent.retention.noExpiry: {name} states no expiry, so it stays until the host removes it.
upload.consent.retention.ownStorage: It stays until you delete it from your own storage.
upload.consent.retention.notStated: {name} does not say how long it keeps the file.
upload.consent.plainHttp: The connection is not encrypted, so anyone on the network path can read the image.
upload.consent.note: Glimpsfy asks this only once for each host.
upload.consent.noteAddress: Glimpsfy asks again if you change the address.
upload.consent.changed: The host's address changed while this dialog was open. Review the new address and confirm again.
upload.terms.visibility.anyoneWithLink: Anyone who has the link can open the file.
upload.terms.visibility.bucketPolicy: The bucket's own access policy decides who can open a file.
upload.terms.visibility.serverOwner: The server's owner decides who can open a file.
upload.terms.visibility.notStated: {name} does not say who can open a file.
upload.terms.retention.bySize: {name} keeps a file for {minDays} to {maxDays} days, and smaller files stay longer.
upload.terms.retention.inactivity: {name} removes a file after {period} without a visit.
upload.terms.retention.noExpiry: {name} states no expiry, so a file stays until the host removes it.
upload.terms.retention.ownStorage: A file stays until you delete it from your own storage.
upload.terms.retention.notStated: {name} does not say how long it keeps a file.
upload.terms.retention.chosen: {name} deletes each file after the time you choose below.
upload.terms.retention.optional: {name} deletes a file after the time you choose below, and with Never its terms do not say how long it stays.
upload.terms.deletion.none: Glimpsfy cannot delete an upload from {name}, so it stays until the host removes it.
upload.terms.deletion.request: Glimpsfy keeps the deletion token, so History can delete the file.
upload.terms.deletion.page: {name} returns a deletion page, which History opens when you delete from the host.
upload.state.copiedLink: The link is on the clipboard.
upload.state.copiedMarkdown: The Markdown image is on the clipboard.
upload.state.opened: The link opened in the browser.
upload.failed.cancelled: You cancelled the upload before the host returned a link.
upload.failed.provider: {name} refused the upload, and its reason is below.
upload.failed.providerStatus: {name} refused the upload with status {status}, and its reason is below.
upload.failed.network: Glimpsfy could not reach {name}. Check your connection and try again.
upload.failed.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than {name} accepts. Choose a smaller capture or another host.
upload.failed.hostNotAllowed: {name} tried to send the upload to another address, so Glimpsfy stopped it.
upload.failed.notConfirmed: Uploads to {name} are not confirmed yet. Upload again and confirm the host first.
upload.failed.missingSecret: {name} needs a key that is not stored yet. Add it in Settings › Upload.
upload.failed.invalidConfig: A setting of {name} is not valid. Fix it in Settings › Upload.
upload.failed.keychain: The keychain refused access. Unlock it and try again.
upload.failed.io: Glimpsfy could not read the file. Check that it still exists.
upload.failed.other: The upload failed. Try again in a moment.
upload.failed.noProvider: No upload host is chosen yet. Choose one in Settings › Upload.
upload.delete.page: {name} deletes uploads on its own page, which is open in the browser now. The entry keeps its link until you delete the upload there.

history.delete.leadMany: The {n} captures leave the history, and the choices below decide what else goes.
history.delete.fileChoice: Move the file to the Trash

history.delete.fileHelpMany: Only the files you saved go to the Trash, where they stay until it is emptied.
history.delete.hostHelp: Everyone who has the link loses access, and this cannot be undone.

history.delete.hostOnly: The file stays in its folder, and the copy on {host} is deleted for everyone.

history.delete.file: The entry leaves the history, and the file waits in the Trash until it is emptied.
history.delete.keepFile: Only the history entry is removed, and the file stays in its folder.
history.delete.ownAndHost: The capture is removed from this Mac, and the copy on {host} is deleted for everyone.
history.delete.ownKeepHost: The capture is removed from this Mac, while the copy on {host} stays online and its link keeps working.
history.delete.own: This capture exists only in the history, so deleting it removes it from this Mac.
history.delete.many.both: The {n} entries, their saved files and their copies on {host} are removed, and the files wait in the Trash.
history.delete.many.file: The {n} entries leave the history, and their saved files wait in the Trash until it is emptied.
history.delete.many.fileKeepHost: The saved files go to the Trash, while the copies on {host} stay online and their links keep working.
history.delete.many.host: The {n} captures are removed from this Mac, and their copies on {host} are deleted for everyone.
history.delete.many.hostKeepFile: The saved files stay in their folders, and the copies on {host} are deleted for everyone.
history.delete.many.none: Only the {n} history entries are removed, and the saved files and the links keep working.
history.delete.many.own: These {n} captures exist only in the history, so deleting them removes them from this Mac.

history.toast.copiedImage: The image is ready to paste.
history.toast.trashed: The saved files went to the Trash.
history.toast.hostedDeletedOne: Deleted the copy on the host.

history.toast.missing: The file of this capture is missing.
history.toast.uploadedCopied: Uploaded the capture and copied its link.
history.inspector.linkOnly: Only the link was kept, because this capture was uploaded without being copied or saved.

record.trim.diskFull: The take stopped on its own because the disk is almost full.

record.export.gifSilent: GIF files carry no sound, so the voice-over only travels in an MP4.

settings.title: Settings

settings.error.notFound: Glimpsfy could not find it ({detail}), so choose it again.

settings.error.other: Something went wrong ({detail}), so try again.

settings.folder.missing: The folder does not exist now, so Glimpsfy makes it at the next save.
settings.folder.readOnly: Glimpsfy may not write in this folder, so saving fails until you choose another one.

settings.general.delayHelp: A delay leaves time to open a menu before the capture.
settings.general.checkUpdatesHelp: Glimpsfy will look at its GitHub releases once a day and install nothing until you confirm.
settings.general.privacy: Glimpsfy has no account and sends no telemetry, and it goes online only to upload, to download a recognition model or to check for updates.
settings.shortcuts.recordScreenHelp: The key that starts a recording also stops it.

settings.shortcuts.overlayDesc: These keys work while the capture tools are open, and they stay fixed.

settings.shortcuts.system.toolbar: macOS uses ⇧⌘5 to open its screenshot toolbar.

settings.output.formatPng: PNG keeps every pixel, which suits text and interface captures.
settings.output.formatJpeg: JPEG suits photos, and it cannot keep transparency.
settings.output.formatWebp: WebP keeps every pixel like PNG, and its files are smaller.
settings.output.retinaHelp: At 1× the width and height are halved, so the file matches the size you saw.
settings.output.copyAfterSave: Copy to the clipboard after saving
settings.output.backgroundHelp: It fills the space around the corners and the shadow, and JPEG always uses white.
settings.output.keepHelp: Older entries leave the history, and files in your save folder stay where they are.
settings.output.keepHelpTrash: Older entries leave the history, and their files in your save folder go to the Trash.
settings.output.trashSaved: Move saved files to the Trash too
settings.output.trashSavedHelp: A file that goes to the Trash can still be put back from there.
settings.output.spaceUnavailable: This build cannot measure the history yet.
settings.output.spaceEmpty: Zero KB · the history is empty
settings.output.clearText: This deletes {count} captures from this Mac and frees {size}. Pinned captures, files in your save folder and links you uploaded stay where they are.
settings.output.clearTextOne: This deletes 1 capture from this Mac and frees {size}. Pinned captures, files in your save folder and links you uploaded stay where they are.
settings.output.clearTextUnknown: This deletes every capture that is not pinned from this Mac. Files in your save folder and links you uploaded stay where they are.
settings.output.clearedNote: The history was cleared, and {size} became free.
settings.recording.videoDesc: Recordings are MP4 files encoded by the hardware of this Mac.
settings.recording.codecHelp: HEVC files are about half the size, and a few older apps cannot play them.
settings.recording.resolutionHelp: Half resolution keeps long recordings small.
settings.recording.systemAudioMissing: This Mac cannot record system audio, so recordings stay without it.
settings.recording.deviceGoneHelp: The saved device is not connected now, so the system default is used until it returns.
settings.recording.devicesUnavailable: This build cannot list devices yet, so the system default is used.
settings.recording.noMicrophones: No microphone is connected, so recordings have no voice.
settings.recording.noCameras: No camera is connected, so recordings show no webcam.
settings.recording.separateTracks: Keep each source on its own track
settings.recording.separateTracksHelp: A mixed track is added as well, so the file still plays everywhere.
settings.recording.keysHelp: The keys appear in a small bar on the recording.
settings.recording.keysOnlyHelp: Only keys pressed with ⌘, ⌥ or ⌃ appear, so typed text and passwords stay out of the video.
settings.recording.webcamDesc: The recording bar turns the camera on, and these rows shape its bubble.
settings.recording.cornerHint: You can drag the bubble to another corner before the recording starts.
settings.recording.gifDesc: The export view starts with these values.
settings.ocr.visionHelp: Vision is built into macOS, runs on the Neural Engine and needs no download.
settings.ocr.windowsOcrHelp: Text recognition is built into Windows and reads the languages whose pack includes it.
settings.ocr.systemEngineHelp: The system's own engine reads the text without a download.
settings.ocr.ppOcrHelp: The open PP-OCR models run on this Mac after a one-time download for each script.
settings.ocr.ppOcrMissing: PP-OCR is not part of this build yet, so it cannot be chosen.
settings.ocr.modelsDesc: Each model downloads once and then works offline.
settings.ocr.modelsMissing: This build cannot download PP-OCR models yet, because the PP-OCR engine is not part of it.
settings.ocr.modelsLoading: Glimpsfy is reading the list of models.
settings.ocr.modelsNone: This build lists no PP-OCR models.
settings.ocr.languagesHelp: With detection on, the ticked languages win when a text could be either. The list comes from the engine.
settings.ocr.languagesDownload: {n} more languages need a download that this build cannot make yet.
settings.ocr.languagesLoading: Glimpsfy is asking the engine for its languages.
settings.ocr.languagesUnavailable: This engine cannot list its languages in this build yet.
settings.ocr.languagesEmpty: The engine lists no languages on this Mac.
settings.ocr.lineBreaksHelp: When this is off, the lines of a paragraph are joined into one.
settings.ocr.codesHelp: A link inside a code appears as an action next to the selection.
settings.ocr.privacy: Recognition runs on this Mac, and no image or text is sent anywhere.
settings.upload.hostsDesc: Glimpsfy uploads only when you ask, and it asks before the first upload to each host.
settings.upload.pickDesc: Each host opens its own page with its terms and settings.
settings.upload.copyHelp: Markdown copies ![](link), which GitHub shows as an image.
settings.upload.openInBrowser: Open the link in the browser
settings.upload.emptyText: Pick a host below to turn on uploads. Until you do, nothing leaves this Mac.
settings.upload.noHostsText: This build offers no upload host, so nothing leaves this Mac.
settings.upload.loadFailedTitle: The hosts could not be listed
settings.upload.testHelp: The test asks the host whether it accepts these settings.
settings.upload.testRefused: {name} refused the test, so check its answer and the settings above.
settings.upload.testFix: Correct the fields marked in red, and test again.
settings.upload.notConfirmed: Glimpsfy asks before the first upload to {name}.
settings.upload.secretKept: The value is now in the macOS Keychain, and the field stays empty so nobody can read it.
settings.upload.secretRemoved: The value was removed from the Keychain.
settings.upload.secretStored: Paste a new value to replace the stored one
settings.upload.pairDuplicate: The name {name} is already in the list, so pick another one.
settings.upload.pairsHelp: The values are kept in the macOS Keychain.
settings.upload.pairsKept: The values you typed are now in the macOS Keychain.
settings.upload.confirmedFor: You confirmed uploads to {destination}, so Glimpsfy no longer asks first.
settings.upload.notConfirmedFor: Glimpsfy asks before the first upload to {destination}.
settings.upload.importHelp: A ShareX .sxcu file fills in the form below, and its header, parameter and argument values go to the keychain.
settings.upload.pairsMissing: Some names have no value in the keychain yet, so type their values again.
settings.upload.secretOnFile: A value is stored in the macOS keychain, and Glimpsfy never shows it again.
settings.upload.testBlocked: The test can run once the settings marked above are complete.
settings.about.licence: Glimpsfy is free software under the MIT licence.
settings.about.welcomeHelp: It shows the permissions and the first steps again.
settings.about.ackDesc: Glimpsfy is built on these projects, and each keeps its own licence.
settings.about.ijg: This software is based in part on the work of the Independent JPEG Group.
popover.capture.label: Capture
popover.delay.label: Delay
popover.recent.unavailable: Recent captures are not available yet.
popover.recent.failed: Glimpsfy could not read the history.
popover.hint: Drag a thumbnail into any app to drop it as a file.
popover.empty.title: Your last five captures appear here.
popover.empty.keys: Press {keys} and drag across the screen to take the first one.
popover.empty.noKeys: Choose Capture area and drag across the screen to take the first one.
popover.act.copied: The capture is on the clipboard.
popover.act.linkCopied: The link is on the clipboard.
popover.perm.title: Screen recording is off
popover.perm.body: Glimpsfy cannot capture the screen until you allow it again in System Settings.
popover.perm.restartBody: macOS applies the permission only after Glimpsfy restarts.
pin.collapsed: Double-click the tile to restore the pin.
pin.loadFailed: Glimpsfy could not load the pinned image.
firstrun.welcome.title: Welcome to Glimpsfy
firstrun.welcome.lead: Glimpsfy needs one permission to capture your screen. The other two are optional, and you can allow them later in Settings.
firstrun.perm.screenRecording.name: Screen Recording
firstrun.perm.screenRecording.why: Glimpsfy needs this permission to capture anything on your screen.
firstrun.perm.microphone.name: Microphone
firstrun.perm.microphone.why: Glimpsfy uses the microphone only when you add your voice to a recording.
firstrun.perm.accessibility.name: Accessibility
firstrun.perm.accessibility.why: Glimpsfy uses this permission to snap the selection to window edges and to show your keystrokes in recordings.
firstrun.wait: Turn on the switch next to Glimpsfy in the list that just opened. Glimpsfy notices the change by itself.
firstrun.restartWhy: macOS applies this permission only after Glimpsfy restarts, and this window opens again at the same step.
firstrun.privacy.title: What stays on this Mac
firstrun.privacy.account: Glimpsfy has no account and sends no usage data.
firstrun.privacy.upload: A capture leaves this Mac only when you upload it, and the first upload to each service asks you first.
firstrun.privacy.ocr: Text recognition runs on this Mac.
firstrun.privacy.screen: This permission lets an app see the whole screen at any time, and Glimpsfy reads it only after you start a capture.
firstrun.privacy.source: The source code is public, so anyone can check these sentences.
firstrun.hint.ok: You can allow the optional ones later in Settings.
firstrun.fin.title: Choose your capture shortcut
firstrun.fin.lead: You will press it many times a day, so pick keys that your hand finds without looking.
firstrun.fin.oursHelp: The macOS screenshot keys keep working next to Glimpsfy.
firstrun.fin.replaceHelp: Glimpsfy opens Keyboard Shortcuts so you can turn the macOS ones off.
firstrun.fin.replaceSteps: Glimpsfy takes these keys for Capture area when you press Done. macOS keeps them until you turn off “Save picture of selected area as a file” under Keyboard Shortcuts › Screenshots, and Glimpsfy never changes that setting for you.
firstrun.fin.loginHelp: Glimpsfy waits in the menu bar and opens no window.
firstrun.fin.loginRefused: macOS did not add Glimpsfy to the login items. You can allow it in System Settings under General › Login Items.
firstrun.fin.tryKeys: Press {keys} and drag across anything on the screen to take your first capture.
firstrun.fin.tryNoKeys: Choose Capture area in the menu bar and drag across anything on the screen to take your first capture.
firstrun.fin.saveFailed: Glimpsfy could not save your choice.
firstrun.fin.keysRefused: Glimpsfy could not take {keys}. Turn the macOS keys off first, or keep the Glimpsfy keys.
toast.savedFallback: {folder} could not be reached, so the capture went here instead.
toast.reason.io: Glimpsfy could not read or write the file.
toast.reason.not_found: The file is no longer there.
toast.reason.capture: macOS could not capture the screen.
toast.reason.invalid_argument: Glimpsfy could not use what it was given.
toast.fix.permission_denied: Allow Glimpsfy under Screen & System Audio Recording in System Settings, then try again.
toast.fix.io: Check that the save folder exists and has free space, then try again.
toast.fix.not_found: Take the capture again, or choose another file.
toast.fix.busy: Finish or close the open capture, then try again.
toast.fix.provider: Check the host in Settings › Upload, then try again.
toast.fix.other: Try again, and restart Glimpsfy if it keeps failing.
toast.diskFull: The disk is almost full, so the recording stopped.
toast.diskFullSaved: Everything recorded until then is saved in {folder}.
update.status.off: This copy does not update itself, because it was not installed from a release.
update.status.offline: Glimpsfy could not reach GitHub, so it tries again later.
update.status.checking: Glimpsfy is looking for a new version.
update.status.ready: Version {version} is downloaded and installs when Glimpsfy restarts.
update.status.available: Version {version} is out, but this copy cannot replace itself, so download it from the releases page.
update.status.installing: Glimpsfy is installing the update and restarts in a moment.
update.status.failedDownload: The download of version {version} failed, so Glimpsfy tries again later.
update.status.failedSignature: The download of version {version} did not match its signature, so Glimpsfy discarded it.
update.status.failedInstall: Version {version} could not be installed, so Glimpsfy keeps running this version.
update.ready.title: Glimpsfy {version} is ready
update.ready.body: The update installs when Glimpsfy restarts, which takes a few seconds.
